caption:
A quick and honest look at next season, for those of you thinking about it:

Weeks 3 to 6 — the heart of January and February — are nearly full. Weeks 1–2 and 7–8 still have space. Christmas week is wide open, and the first Easter bookings just came in.

We keep the groups small, so when a week is full, it's full. If you have a week in mind, now is the time to say so — especially if you're a group of 4 or more and want a whole house to yourselves.

Send us a message and we'll find the week that fits.
